reviews.review: One of the best games i have ever played. As soon as i started playing it i knew that it was worth every penny.

EDF5 Makes uh I'm not allowed to post that nvm.

Let's just say fencer is big funny. I love all the classes tho.

kill bugs, behead bugs, roundhouse kick bugs into the concrete, slam dunk a bug baby into the trash can, crucify filthy bugs, defecate into bugs food, launch bugs into the sun, stir fry bugs in a wok, toss bugs into active volcanoes, urinate into bug's gas tank, Judo throw bugs into a wood chipper, twist bugs heads off, report bugs to the IRS, karate chop bugs in half, curb stomp pregnant bugs, trap bugs in quicksand, Crush bugs in the trash compactor, liquify bugs in a vat of acid, eat bugs, dissect bugs, exterminate bugs in the gas chamber, stomp Bug skulls with steel-toed boots, cremate bugs in the oven, lobotomized bugs, mandatory abortions for bugs, grind Bug fetuses in the garbage disposal, drown bugs in fried chicken grease, vaporize bugs with a raygun, kick old bugs down the stairs, feed bugs to alligators, slice bugs with a katana

This is just a PSA for everyone, but especially if you are new to this franchise or a returning player and don't know which game to get, let me just warn you now: don't bother buying this game as it's an inferior product. I'm telling you, just buy EDF6 instead as it improves upon all aspects of the franchise so far and implements quality of life and gameplay enhancements that they've learned from decades of experience. I suppose you could even say they 'casualized' the gameplay to a degree, but this time for the better. Although 6 is a continuation of 5 and D3 recommends you play 5 first, it doesn't really matter as 6 basically covers the "story" of 5 anyway, so you aren't missing out on that. This doesn't have STEAM integration, so you have to go through their in-game room systems, which are very wonky, instead of just right-clicking your STEAM friend and clicking join through friends list and jumping right into the action; the classes are terrible to control and have worse weapons; and the whole game feels much slower like you are moving through molasses, which makes the game feel very frustrating and not fun at all to play despite the obvious shlocky Starship Troopers/GANTZ tone they are going for. Just save your money and your sanity and your friends/family sanity and get EDF6 instead. I've played every single game in the franchise so far. Just trust me bro.
